page_title: HOL 2-2 BOC | Holstein Kiel v Bochum 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' The free kick from long range, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' David Zec (Holstein Kiel) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+4' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Georgios Masouras walks off the pitch to be replaced by Erhan Masovic (Bochum).
90+4' Here is a change. Matus Bero is going off and Dieter Hecking gives the last tactical orders to Dani de Wit (Bochum).
90+2' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' John Tolkin (Holstein Kiel) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
84' A great run from Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just over the bar.
82' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) serves up a nice cross, but Patrick Drewes punches the ball away.
81' The attendance is 15034.
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is replacing Tom Krauss.
78' The free kick from long range, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' The goal by Holstein Kiel is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
75' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Holstein Kiel players aren’t happy.
73' Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
73' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
72' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
70' Felix Passlack (Bochum) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Timon Weiner intercepts the ball.
69' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot. Unfortunately for him, it goes inches wide of the left post.
68' Matus Bero (Bochum) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
67' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
64' The resulting corner from John Tolkin (Holstein Kiel) comes to nothing.
61' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Timon Weiner, who smothers the ball.
60' Matus Bero (Bochum) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
57' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.

57' Bernardo (Bochum) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Timon Weiner with a fabulous save.
56' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bochum.
55' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Bochum will take a corner kick.
54' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
52' Bernardo (Bochum) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the right post.
52' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
50' 2 - 2 John Tolkin launches a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where David Zec (Holstein Kiel) rises high to head the ball into the right side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. 2:2.

50' Felix Zwayer blows for a foul after Matus Bero (Bochum) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Holstein Kiel win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
48' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
46' Half-time substitution. Gerrit Holtmann will not participate anymore and Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is coming on.
46' Marcel Rapp makes a half-time substitution. Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) comes on in place of Finn Porath.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marcel Rapp probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lasse Rosenboom. He is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Felix Passlack (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
45+4' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
45+3' A short through ball almost allows Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
45+2' Substitution. Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) on for Myron Boadu.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Myron Boadu (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
44' What a big chance! Felix Passlack (Bochum) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
42' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
39' 1 - 2 Myron Boadu (Bochum) finds some space in front of goal and scores after heading the ball into the roof of the net!
37' 1 - 1 Myron Boadu (Bochum) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
35' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bochum.
32' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
31' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
30' John Tolkin (Holstein Kiel) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
26' Tim Oermann (Bochum) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Problems for Marcel Rapp as Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Shuto Machino replaces him.
25' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) is penalised for a foul. Felix Zwayer had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Holstein Kiel.
22' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
22' Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
21' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
19' Marco Komenda is being substituted because of an injury. Marcel Rapp sends Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) on the pitch.
17' Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
16' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
13' What a save from Timon Weiner! Felix Passlack (Bochum) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
12' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Bochum win a corner.
11' Myron Boadu (Bochum) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
10' The ball is out of play. Bochum will take a throw-in.
7' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
7' Holstein Kiel have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
6' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Bochum! Play can continue.
6' There's a break in play and referee Felix Zwayer must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bochum using VAR. This could be interesting!
5' Surely that's handball by one of the Holstein Kiel players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Patrick Drewes into the bottom left corner.
2' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
2' Handball! A player from Bochum handled the ball. That is a penalty kick for Holstein Kiel.
1' Holstein Kiel take a short corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bochum will kick the game off.
Felix Zwayer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
